decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on the well-received BASIC 518 and the website reports positive customer reception, so results appear to meet aspirations and give no reason to search for alternatives.

The flail shredder line has its own dedicated page, which signals management commitment, and an established mid-sized machinery firm has enough slack to carry a product line whose results are still uncertain.
The grinder line is only mentioned and no results are reported, but it fits the core mobile shredding portfolio and is too early to judge against aspirations, so the firm likely keeps it for now.
The stationary electric fine shredder has low visibility and no reported results, which raises the risk of a shortfall, but it supports the firm's strategic stationary and resource-saving direction.
The green-waste grinder line overlaps with Product C and has no evidence of success, which makes it a candidate for consolidation, but one year is too short for problemistic search to trigger a drop.
The single-shaft pre-shredder line has its own page and extends the firm into stationary plants, in line with its strategy, so management likely sees it as meeting expectations.
